headline: OKX Ethereum Long Accounts Fell To 1.81 Per Short Account From 2.37
narrative: The OKX ethereum contract account ratio fell to 1.81 long accounts per short account from 2.37 over the latest day. The pipe counts accounts on one venue, not dollars and not position size, and a lower ratio means fewer accounts are positioned long relative to accounts positioned short. A 2.37 reading ranks in the 96.0 percentile of the last 720 hourly prints, and 1.81 ranks in the 70.0 percentile.
author: jordan
